title: Successive inner product prefixes
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $2m$, and let $k<m$. The prefix sum through the first $k+1$ coordinate pairs equals the prefix sum through the first $k$ pairs plus the product in $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the two bits in pair $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $2m$
